title: rhododendron indicum var. obtusum
intro: Rhododendron indicum var. obtusum, commonly known as the 'Obtuse-leaved Rhododendron', is a plant species within the Rhododendron genus, known for its distinctive leaves and medicinal properties. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron indicum var. obtusum include its ability to reduce pain, lower blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a popular choice in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
